profile.org_note: Beazer's FY2025 10-K reports three segments (West, East, Southeast) but runs the field through divisions, each led by a regional market leader and/or an area president who reports straight to the CEO (Allan Merrill); no segment- or region-level president is disclosed, and land capital is committed through consultation among executive and operational staff, with job postings showing division land VPs rolling up to an unnamed SVP of Land Acquisition. Since 2026-10-20 Beazer is a Dream Finders subsidiary: land and capital decisions sit with Dream Finders (CEO Patrick Zalupski, CFO Anabel Ramsay, COO Clint Szubinski) under a 100% land-light model, and Dream Finders' Q3 2026 10-Q (Southeast / Mid-Atlantic / Midwest segments) has not yet said how the Beazer divisions map into its segments.
profile.summary: Builder 100 #21 (4,427 closings in 2025), 13 states and about 18 metro markets across West, East and Southeast segments; acquired by Dream Finders Homes for $33.50 a share (about $2.2B enterprise value) on 2026-10-20 and delisted. Beazer controlled 25,660 lots at 2025-09-30 with 62% of active lots under option, and Dream Finders says it will run the combined company 100% land-light. At closing Dream Finders sold pre-acquisition Beazer land to Millrose under a $572.1M land bank facility and used the proceeds to redeem Beazer's 2029 notes and repay its revolver; affiliates of Kennedy Lewis were among the committed financing sources.

people.name: Allan P. Merrill
people.title: President and Chief Executive Officer
people.prior_role: Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer of Beazer (joined May 2007)
people.source_title: Beazer Homes Form 8-K, completion of merger with Dream Finders Homes
people.note: Resigned as a director (and so as Chairman) at the merger's effective time on 2026-10-20. Beazer became a wholly owned subsidiary of Dream Finders Homes on 2026-10-20. The closing 8-K says the officers in place immediately before the merger continued as officers of the surviving company, but no post-closing role inside Dream Finders has been announced; confirm before calling. Title per the December 2025 proxy and the September 2026 merger proxy; he led the sale process for Beazer. Title note: Chairman of the Board until 2026-10-20.

people.name: David I. Goldberg
people.title: Senior Vice President and Chief Financial Officer
people.prior_role: Vice President, Treasurer and Head of Investor Relations at Beazer (joined March 2015); before that lead US housing equity analyst at UBS
people.source_title: Beazer Homes Form 8-K, completion of merger with Dream Finders Homes
people.note: Signed the 2026-10-20 closing 8-K as SVP and CFO. Also signs for every subsidiary guarantor on the credit agreement and is President and CEO of Beazer Mortgage Corporation, and came up through the treasurer seat, so he is effectively Beazer's capital-markets head. Email is published as the media contact in Beazer's 2026-08-07 employee communication filed with the SEC. Beazer became a wholly owned subsidiary of Dream Finders Homes on 2026-10-20. The closing 8-K says the officers in place immediately before the merger continued as officers of the surviving company, but no post-closing role inside Dream Finders has been announced; confirm before calling. Texas Comptroller franchise-tax record for subsidiary Beazer Fundamental, LLC (report year 2026) lists him as Treasurer, and the Beazer Homes Texas Holdings record lists him as CFO, which supports treating him as the treasury head.

gaps: Post-merger roles of Allan Merrill, David Goldberg, Michael Dunn and Pei Sun: not publicly disclosed. The closing 8-K says pre-merger officers continued as officers of the surviving company, and nothing further has been announced.

Treasurer: no separate treasurer named in filings. David Goldberg held the treasurer title until 2020, still signs all credit documents, and the Texas Comptroller record for subsidiary Beazer Fundamental, LLC (2026) lists him as Treasurer; investor relations is run by VP Mark Chekanow.

Head of land acquisition (corporate): a Feb 2026 Roseville, CA job posting (seen in search snippet, page now 410) says VP-level land staff report to a Senior Vice President of Land Acquisition, but that person is not named in any public source opened. The Org lists Erica Champion as Chief Investment Officer and The Official Board lists Matt Williams as National VP of Land Development; both are unconfirmed and tagged Inferred.

Area presidents / regional market leaders: the FY2025 10-K confirms the roles exist and report to the CEO, but names nobody. Area-president names found in search (e.g. a 2018 Charleston/Myrtle Beach appointment, and undated ZoomInfo/Yahoo directory entries) are too old or unreliable to list as current.
Division presidents: none named on beazer.com market pages; left to the division-president sweep.
Chief Information Officer and Chief Information Security Officer: referred to in the proxy and 10-K but not named.
Land, treasury and area-president names: only partly confirmed. Beazer's investor site (ir.beazer.com) has not been readable since the delisting, so old investor decks were not read.

Texas Comptroller record for Beazer Homes Texas Holdings, Inc. (report year 2026) still lists Keith Belknap as General Counsel, which conflicts with the proxy (Michael Dunn has been GC since 2024-08); treated as a stale state filing and not listed.
Regional president for West (AZ, CA, NV, TX): not publicly disclosed
Regional president for East (IN, MD/DE, TN, VA): not publicly disclosed
Regional president for Southeast (FL, GA, NC, SC): not publicly disclosed

Area presidents: the FY2025 10-K confirms area presidents / regional market leaders lead the divisions and report to the CEO, but names none. Only Bruce Craig (aggregator, no area or date; tagged Inferred) is carried. Troy Radelat and Steven Cervino appear as 'Area President' only on ZoomInfo/The Org snippets (not sources), and Jay Thrower (Area President, Charleston and Myrtle Beach, Feb 2018 release) has no 2025-2026 confirmation; none carried.

Post-merger regional structure: Dream Finders' Q3 2026 10-Q (period to 2026-09-30) keeps its Southeast / Mid-Atlantic / Midwest segments and does not assign the Beazer divisions; HousingWire's integration pieces (2026-08-03, 2026-08-11) name no Beazer regional or land leaders.

Corporate land head: Senior Vice President of Land Acquisition (referenced in job postings) still unnamed after a second targeted pass; a search for Erica Champion (The Org 'Chief Investment Officer') found no confirming source.
